change.title: stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields

source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses stripe-node 14.5.0, explicitly pinned to API version 2023-10-16. None of the 2026 changes break it today, because the pinned version keeps working. The upgrade to stripe-node 23 (endive) is still a single coherent move that crosses majors 15–23. Edits required: bump the package, change apiVersion to 2026-09-30.endive, and remove payment_method_types from the Checkout Session create, which would otherwise 400. Also keep using constructEvent for webhook parsing, re-check how subscription period fields are read after the basil move to subscription items, and fix TypeScript type changes. The webhook endpoint's API version is set in the Stripe Dashboard and should be bumped together with the code, so payloads match the new types. Uncertain: Node majors 15–18 are not in this change list (notably basil's current_period_end move), so the migration agent should read the stripe-node CHANGELOG for those too. Urgency is medium: nothing breaks until someone upgrades, but the SDK is nine majors behind and the bump touches the checkout and billing paths.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23.0.0 pins 2026-09-30.endive. Moving the SDK and the apiVersion in src/lib/stripe.ts to 23 / endive is the same edit.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. checkout.sessions.create in src/trpc/index.ts:152 passes payment_method_types. On endive this returns a 400, so the parameter must be dropped as part of the bump (rely on dynamic payment methods).
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. Going from 2023-10-16 to endive passes through dahlia. Its breaking items are reviewed in the same upgrade.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. An intermediate major crossed by the 14.5.0 -> 23 jump. Confirm Stripe is constructed with `new Stripe()` in src/lib/stripe.ts and adapt to the reworked types.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. An intermediate major crossed by the jump. In the webhook route, calling the wrong parsing method now throws, so constructEvent must stay the method used for v1 snapshot events. decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:node-20-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 20.0.0: pins 2025-11-17.clover; v2 array params use indexed serialization (may break mock-server tests), effective 2025-11-18. An intermediate major (2025-11-17.clover) crossed by the jump. Only v2 array serialization changes, and the repo has no v2 calls.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "This may break any unit tests that expect the latter behavior when setting up a mock server."
- stripe:node-19-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 19.0.0: pins 2025-09-30.clover; parseThinEvent renamed parseEventNotification, v2 delete returns V2DeletedObject, v2 nullable props optional; 19.x deprecated (Files API timeout bug), effective 2025-09-30. An intermediate major (2025-09-30.clover) crossed by the jump. The parseThinEvent rename and v2 changes do not touch this code but are part of the same bump.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Rename function `StripeClient.parseThinEvent` to `StripeClient.parseEventNotification` and remove the `Stripe.ThinEvent` interface."

callSites.why: The client is pinned to apiVersion '2023-10-16'. The SDK's TypeScript types expect the SDK-pinned version, so this must move to 2026-09-30.endive with the upgrade.
checkout.sessions.create passes payment_method_types, which is removed on endive (400 payment_method_types_no_longer_supported).
webhooks.constructEvent: from node 21 the wrong parsing method throws. The event payload shape follows the newer API version once the webhook endpoint version is bumped.

subscriptions.retrieve response shape changes across basil/clover/dahlia/endive. In particular, current_period_end/current_period_start moved from Subscription to subscription items in 2025-03-31.basil.
Same subscriptions.retrieve response-shape risk (current_period_end moved to items).
subscriptions.retrieve response is read for plan status. Check fields such as current_period_end and price id under the new version.
billingPortal.sessions.create runs under the new API version. No known breaking change, but verify the types compile.

## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Verified]

### Change

Upgraded stripe 14.5.0 to 23.0.0 with npm. Set apiVersion to 2026-09-30.endive. Removed payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create. In the webhook, the period end is now read from items.data[0].current_period_end. The invoice.payment_succeeded branch now takes the subscription from invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription and returns 200 if it is missing. constructEvent is unchanged, and the client already uses new Stripe(). Typecheck and build pass. I added test/stripe-v23.check.mjs, a source-grep check that fails on the original code and passes now.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`
- `src/lib/stripe.ts`
- `src/trpc/index.ts`
- `test/stripe-v23.check.mjs`

### Why

The v23 types and the endive API removed subscription.current_period_end (it moved to items), removed invoice.subscription (now under parent), and removed checkout payment_method_types. The apiVersion literal must equal the SDK's pin.

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| stripe-v23-check | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- stripe-v23-check, added by the agent: `export DATABASE_URL='postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db' PINECONE_API_KEY='placeholder' PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT='placeholder' OPENAI_API_KEY='placeholder' STRIPE_SECRET_KEY='placeholder' UPLOADTHING_SECRET='placeholder' UPLOADTHING_APP_ID='placeholder' GOOGLE_API_KEY='placeholder'; node test/stripe-v23.check.mjs` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The repo's postinstall hook runs prisma generate, which was skipped. It creates the Prisma client types that typecheck and build need to import from @prisma/client.); it exited 0.
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The postinstall hook (prisma generate) was skipped, so the Prisma client types and code must be generated.); it exited 0.
- Before the baseline the harness ran `[ -f next-env.d.ts ] || printf '/// <reference types="next" />\n/// <reference types="next/image-types/global" />\n\n// NOTE: This file should not be edited\n' > next-env.d.ts` (next-env.d.ts is generated by next dev/build and declares the *.jpg module types. Without it, tsc cannot resolve the image imports in src/app/page.tsx.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, PINECONE_API_KEY, PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT, OPENAI_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, UPLOADTHING_SECRET, UPLOADTHING_APP_ID, GOOGLE_API_KEY.

Test of this change: `stripe-v23-check`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- No provider validators were run (stripe_check_params was not called).
- Endive response shapes were not checked with live calls.
- The Stripe Dashboard webhook endpoint's API version must be moved to endive.
- The deploy runtime must be Node >=20.
- items.data[0] assumes single-item subscriptions.
- The metadata.userId early return in the webhook predates this change and may swallow invoice events, since invoices lack that metadata. I left it alone.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout no longer restricts payment methods to card. Dynamic payment methods apply, so customers may see other methods.
- The invoice.payment_succeeded handler returns 200 early when the invoice has no subscription reference.
- A missing item period end is stored as epoch 0, so the subscription reads as expired.

---

review.summary: The headline removal (`constructEventWithoutVerification`) is never used here. The real work is the jump from SDK 14 / API 2023-10-16 to 23 / 2026-09-30.endive. The diff moves `current_period_end` to subscription items and reads the invoice's subscription from `parent.subscription_details`. Both match how I understand the newer API versions, and typecheck passing against v23 types supports them. However, the checks are a string-grep script plus typecheck/build; no webhook path is exercised. The new invoice parsing depends on the API version of the Stripe webhook endpoint, not the SDK pin. The diff also drops `payment_method_types`, which the upgrade does not require. The 'verified' grade overstates what was proven.

concerns.issue: Webhook event payloads are rendered at the API version configured on the Stripe webhook endpoint, not the SDK's `apiVersion`. If the endpoint is still on 2023-10-16 (or any pre-basil version), invoices arrive with top-level `subscription` and no `parent`. The new code at ~L59-64 then finds no subscriptionId and silently returns 200, so renewals stop updating `stripeCurrentPeriodEnd`. Users would then appear unsubscribed one day after their period ends (`isSubscribed` in src/lib/stripe.ts:39-43). The endpoint version must be bumped in the Dashboard alongside this deploy, or the code should fall back to the legacy field.

Removing `payment_method_types: ["card"]` (L155) is a behaviour change the upgrade does not force; the parameter is still accepted as far as I know. Checkout will now offer whatever payment methods are enabled in the Dashboard, which may include delayed-notification methods that the webhook does not handle. Confirm this is intended or restore the parameter.

`(items.data[0]?.current_period_end ?? 0) * 1000` writes a 1970 date if the field is missing. That silently marks a paying user as unsubscribed instead of failing loudly. Consider throwing or skipping the update.

This is pre-existing and not introduced by the diff. The early return at L30-34 requires `metadata.userId` on every event object. Invoices normally do not carry the checkout session's metadata, so the `invoice.payment_succeeded` branch (including the new `parent` logic) is likely unreachable in practice. The migration therefore cannot be validated through that branch.
stripe@23 declares engines node >=20. The deploy runtime (e.g. Vercel project Node version) must be 20+. The checks run locally and do not prove this.

The added check only greps source strings and the installed version; it does not run any Stripe call or webhook. The `verified` grade rests on typecheck plus string presence, so it should arguably be needs-review.

Decide whether dropping `payment_method_types: ["card"]` in src/trpc/index.ts is intended.

Replay checkout.session.completed and invoice.payment_succeeded with `stripe trigger` / the Stripe CLI against the endpoint and confirm the DB updates. Note that the userId-metadata guard likely blocks the invoice branch.
Confirm the hosting runtime is Node >=20.
I could not confirm '2026-09-30.endive' from memory. Verify the string against the `apiVersion` type in node_modules/stripe (typecheck passing suggests it matches).
